title: 第8章 听从安排
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 六月的京城，像个密不透风的大蒸笼。日头明晃晃地挂在空中，晒得四合院里的青石板发烫，连那棵老槐树上的知了都有气无力地叫着，声音嘶哑。辰楠坐在大厅里，手里拿着一把破蒲扇，有一下没一下地扇着。他还是不太适应这个没有空调与电风扇的年代。电风扇在60年代已经出现，但很多家庭都舍不得买，不仅贵还要工业票才能购买。汗水顺着他的额角滑下，浸湿了身上那件洗得发白的背心。就在这时。房门吱呀一声。母亲李秀兰拖着疲惫的身子走了进来。她穿着一身藏蓝色的工装，后背已经被汗水浸透了一大片。纺织厂里机器轰鸣，车间温度比外面还要高上几分，一天下来，整个人像是从水里捞出来似的。“妈，回来了。”辰楠起身接过母亲手里的布包。李秀兰擦了把汗，刚要开口，隔壁王大妈就端着个搪瓷缸子凑了过来：“秀兰啊，你可算回来了！今天你家小楠可了不得，把常伟那小子给打了一顿。”辰楠有心想要制止王大妈的八卦，要是老妈知道那事情后得气疯啊。可还没等他开口，就被老妈子扒拉到了一旁。辰楠无奈，只能做饭去。王大妈绘声绘色地把下午发生的事情讲了一遍，添油加醋，唾沫横飞。李秀兰的脸色随着她的讲述越来越难看，拳头不自觉地攥紧了。“这个柳如意，真是欺人太甚！”李秀兰气得浑身发抖，转身就要往外冲，“我找她算账去！小小年纪就这么恶毒，长大了还得了！”辰楠连忙拉住母亲：“妈，您别冲动。为这种人气坏身子，不值当。”“可是他们差点害死你啊！”李秀兰眼圈红了，声音哽咽，“要不是你命大，妈就见不到你了...”“不仅如此，他们还敢上门找事，这是欺负我们老辰家没人吗？”辰楠心里一暖，前世他是孤儿，从未体会过母亲的关爱。如今看着李秀兰为自已着急落泪，他真切地感受到了亲情的力量。“妈，我这不是好好的嘛。”辰楠扶着母亲在小凳上坐下，“这笔账我会慢慢算，但不是现在。您放心，我心里有数。”李秀兰看着儿子沉稳的眼神，忽然觉得这孩子落水之后像是变了个人。从前遇到事总是畏畏缩缩，如今却有一种说不出的从容。“那你答应妈，离那两个人远点。”李秀兰抹了把眼泪，“常伟他爸是厂领导，惹他们有点麻烦。”辰楠点点头：“我晓得轻重。”李秀兰这才稍稍安心，两人又闲聊了会。王大妈见没自已啥事，也就回家去了。李秀兰平复了情绪，返回里屋看老辰去了。半个小时后，她才起身去厨房准备晚饭。不一会儿，烟囱里冒出了袅袅炊烟。傍晚时分。一家三口围坐在大厅的小桌前吃饭。晚饭很简单：一盆稀得能照见人影的粥，一盘黄澄澄的南瓜饼。辰楠咬了一口南瓜饼，口感粗糙，带着一股生涩的南瓜味，几乎没有油水。稀粥更是淡而无味，喝下去只觉得肚子胀，却不顶饿。“妈，这南瓜饼做得不错。”辰楠强忍着不适，夸赞道。李秀兰笑了：“就你嘴甜，这还是你爸前些天从市场换回来的南瓜，我琢磨着做成饼能多吃几顿。”辰楠默默吃着，偶尔抬头看看父母，眼神复杂。他比谁都清楚家里的粮食紧张。他们三人是城市户口，可是九个妹妹都是乡下户口，三个人的定量要养活九张嘴，省出钱来寄回老家给爷奶，实在是捉襟见肘。他们不是没想到把妹妹的户籍弄到城里来，可这难度很大，需要人脉去走动，需要金钱去开路。因此暂时只能搁浅下来。辰楠看着父母消瘦的面庞，心里不是滋味。前世他虽然不算富裕，但至少吃喝不愁。如今到了这个物资匮乏的年代，才真切体会到“吃不饱”是什么滋味。“得尽快搞点粮食回来了。”辰楠暗下决心。饭后，李秀兰收拾好碗筷，从床底下拖出一个鼓鼓囊囊的麻布口袋。“小楠，妈和你爸商量过了。”李秀兰拍了拍口袋，“你把这袋东西带回乡下，去看看你爷和妹妹们。”辰楠一愣，“回乡下？”“嗯。”辰东南接口道，“你这没工作，整天无所事事，昨天还掉河里，我跟你妈这心里不踏实。”“再说你今天打了那个常伟，虽然是他理亏，但搞不好他们会暗中报复，你先回乡下避避风头。”李秀兰接着说：“乡下山清水秀，空气也好。你爷和你九个妹妹都在那儿，你回去陪陪他们，顺便帮帮忙。”辰楠这才明白父母的良苦用心。他们不仅是担心常伟报复，更是想让他远离柳如意这个“祸水”。想到乡下有山有林，打猎方便，比城里更容易找到食物，辰楠心动了。“行，我听你们的安排。”辰楠答应道，“过两天吧，我还有些事情要处理。”辰东南和李秀兰对视一眼，松了口气。他们生怕儿子舍不得离开城里。“不急，你安排好就行。”李秀兰把麻袋推到辰楠面前，“这里面有些旧衣服，还有我攒下来的几斤粮票。你带回去，给妹妹们添件衣裳，买点吃的。”李秀兰其实也很想回去，可是她没假期，想回乡下看看女儿都难。乡下那九个孩子都是她身上掉下的一块肉，实在是挂念得很，可是为了生活不得不背井离乡。她这算是极其幸运的，很多人想要一份工作都不可能，而她在老辰的帮助下才得以进入纺织厂。“我知道了。”辰楠掂了掂袋子，心里沉甸甸的。他知道这些东西都是父母从牙缝里省出来的。“爸，妈，你们放心。”辰楠郑重地说，“我会照顾好妹妹们，也会想办法改善家里的情况。”辰东南与李秀兰对视一眼，都看到了彼此眼里得到欣慰。夜幕降临，夜深人静。辰楠躺在床上，意识进入空间小世界。经过灵泉溪水的滋润，南瓜已经长得有篮球那么大，金灿灿的十分喜人。意念一动，溪水无风自动飘起，朝着南瓜苗而去，溪水就像是灵活的黑蛇。做完这一切，辰楠退出了空间。他把精神力作用在单独一棵南瓜苗上，这一根苗上有十来个南瓜。在精神力的催生下，南瓜果实慢慢长大。随着时间的流逝，辰楠愈发的觉得脑袋昏沉沉的，什么时候睡了过去都不知道。
content_en: The capital in June is like a big airtight steamer.The sun hung brightly in the sky, making the bluestones in the courtyard very hot. Even the cicadas on the old locust tree screamed feebly and hoarsely.Chen Nan was sitting in the hall, holding a broken cattail leaf fan in his hand and fanning it constantly.He is still not used to this era without air conditioners and electric fans.Electric fans have appeared in the 1960s, but many families are reluctant to buy them. Not only are they expensive, but they require industrial fees to purchase them.Sweat slid down his forehead, soaking the washed-white vest on his body.Just then.The door creaked.Mother Li Xiulan walked in dragging her tired body.She was wearing a navy blue overalls, and her back was soaked with sweat.The machines in the textile factory were roaring, and the temperature in the workshop was slightly higher than outside. At the end of the day, the whole person felt as if he had been fished out of water."Mom, I'm back." Chen Nan stood up and took the cloth bag from her mother's hand.Li Xiulan wiped her sweat and was about to speak when Aunt Wang from next door came over with an enamel vat: "Xiulan, you're back! Your Xiao Nan was so awesome today that she beat up that boy Chang Wei." Chen Nan deliberately wanted to stop Aunt Wang's gossip. If her mother knew about it, she would go crazy.But before he could speak, he was pulled aside by the old lady.Chen Nan had no choice but to cook.Aunt Wang vividly recounted what happened that afternoon, adding fuel to the fire and spitting.Li Xiulan's face became more and more ugly as she told her story, and her fists clenched unconsciously."This Liu Ruyi is really bullying!" Li Xiulan was trembling with anger, turned around and was about to rush out, "I'm going to settle the score with her! She was so vicious at a young age, and she will be worse when she grows up!" Chen Nan quickly grabbed her mother: "Mom, don't be impulsive. It's not worth it to be so angry for such a person." "But he is.They almost killed you!" Li Xiulan's eyes were red and her voice was choked, "If you weren't lucky, mom wouldn't be able to see you..." "Not only that, they dare to come to the door to make trouble.Are they bullying everyone in our old Chen family?" Chen Nan felt warm in his heart. He was an orphan in his previous life and had never experienced his mother's care.Now seeing Li Xiulan crying anxiously for herself, he truly felt the power of family affection."Mom, isn't this a good thing for me." Chen Nan helped her mother sit down on the small stool, "I will settle this account slowly, but not now. Don't worry, I know it well." Li Xiulan looked at her son's calm eyes, and suddenly felt that the child seemed to have changed after falling into the water.In the past, I was always timid when encountering things, but now I have an indescribable calmness."Then you promise mom, stay away from those two people." Li Xiulan wiped away her tears, "Chang Wei's father is the factory leader, and it's a bit troublesome to cause them." Chen Nan nodded: "I know the severity." Li Xiulan felt relieved, and the two chatted for a while.Aunt Wang saw that nothing happened to her, so she went home.Li Xiulan calmed down and returned to the back room to see Lao Chen.Half an hour later, she got up and went to the kitchen to prepare dinner.After a while, smoke came from the chimney.Late afternoon.A family of three sat around a small table in the hall to eat.Dinner was very simple: a bowl of porridge so thin that you could see the shadow of a person, and a plate of yellow pumpkin pie.Chen Nan took a bite of the pumpkin pie. It had a rough texture, with a harsh pumpkin flavor and almost no oil or water.The gruel is even more bland and tasteless. After drinking it, I feel bloated but not hungry."Mom, this pumpkin pie is well made." Chen Nan endured the discomfort and praised.Li Xiulan smiled: "You're the only one with a sweet mouth. This is the pumpkin your dad brought back from the market a few days ago. I'm thinking about making it into pancakes so I can eat more meals." Chen Nan ate silently, occasionally looking up at her parents with complicated eyes.He knows better than anyone the food shortage at home.The three of them have urban household registrations, but the nine younger sisters all have rural household registrations. The ration for three people has to feed nine mouths. It is really difficult to save money to send back to their hometown to give to their grandparents.It's not that they didn't expect to get their sister's household registration into the city, but it was very difficult. They needed connections to move around and money to open the way.So it can only be put on hold for the time being.Chen Nan felt uncomfortable looking at the thin faces of her parents.Although he was not rich in his previous life, at least he had enough to eat and drink.Now in this era of scarcity, we truly understand what it feels like to not have enough to eat."We have to get some food back as soon as possible." Chen Nan secretly made up his mind.After the meal, Li Xiulan put away the dishes and pulled out a bulging linen bag from under the bed."Xiao Nan, mom and your dad have discussed this." Li Xiulan patted her pocket, "Take this bag of things back to the countryside to see your father and sisters." Chen Nan was stunned, "Back to the countryside?" "Yeah." Chen Nannan said, "You have no job, nothing to do all day long, and you fell into the river yesterday. Your mother and I are not at ease anymore." "No more."You said you beat that Chang Wei today. Although he was wrong, they might retaliate secretly. You should go back to the countryside to avoid the limelight."Li Xiulan continued, "The countryside is beautiful and the air is good.Your father and your nine sisters are there.You go back to accompany them and help them." Chen Nan then understood his parents' good intentions.Not only were they worried about Chang Wei's revenge, but they also wanted him to stay away from the "disaster" Liu Ruyi.Chen Nan was moved by the thought that there were mountains and forests in the countryside, where hunting was convenient and it was easier to find food than in the city."Okay, I'll follow your arrangements." Chen Nan promised, "In two days, I still have some things to deal with." Chen Nannan and Li Xiulan looked at each other and breathed a sigh of relief.They were afraid that their son would be reluctant to leave the city."There's no rush, just make arrangements." Li Xiulan pushed the sack in front of Chen Nan, "There are some old clothes in here, as well as a few kilograms of food stamps I saved. You can take them back and buy some clothes for the sisters and buy some food." Li Xiulan actually wanted to go back, but she didn't have a holiday, and it was difficult to go back to the countryside to see her daughter.Those nine children in the countryside were all the pieces of flesh she had left behind. She really missed them very much, but she had to leave her hometown in order to make a living.She was extremely lucky. It was impossible for many people to get a job, but with the help of Lao Chen, she was able to enter the textile factory."I know." Chen Nan weighed the bag, her heart heavy.He knew that these things were saved by his parents from between their teeth."Dad, Mom, don't worry." Chen Nan said solemnly, "I will take good care of my sisters and find ways to improve the situation at home." Chen Nannan and Li Xiulan looked at each other and saw relief in each other's eyes.Night falls, and it is quiet.Chen Nan was lying on the bed, and his consciousness entered the small world of space.After being nourished by the Lingquan stream, the pumpkin has grown as big as a basketball, and its golden color is very pleasing.With a thought, the stream automatically floated up without wind, heading towards the pumpkin seedlings. The stream looked like a flexible black snake.After doing all this, Chen Nan exited the space.He used his mental power on a single pumpkin seedling, and there were more than ten pumpkins on this seedling.Under the stimulation of spiritual power, the pumpkin fruit slowly grows.As time went by, Chen Nan felt more and more dizzy, and he didn't know when he fell asleep.
